title: Data Preserve
tagline: Data preserve is a Crowd-funded dataset preservation platform that allows anyone to fund storing societally important data like crime statistics or environmental warming)
description:
Many humanity's important datsets like climate data, crime statistics data, etc needs funding for long-term storage. The aim is to allow users to create Data Projects that need funding to connect with potential funders.

Clients
- Create a data project
- Mentions data cid, target goal amount, file size

Funders
- Can see all data that needs funding and preservation
- Fund the data with FIL
- Earn badges for their contribution

A lot of data on filecoin network will expire in coming days, weeks and months that will require funding. Data Preserve platform enables a funding method for all datasets that don't have any source of adequate funding
how_its_made:
Built smart contracts using solidity and FVM hardhat kit and deployed to FEVM - Filecoin wallaby testnet. One of the few apps built on FVM at the moment

FEVM just launched last month and there can a lot of potential applications that can leverage its data storage combined with this new smart contract functionality.
